caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed object within a thin rectangular border on a cream-colored background. The object is a small, rectangular, and slightly rounded block that appears metallic or stone-like, with a textured surface marked by diagonal lines in a uniform pattern. Its color is predominantly dark gray with lighter and darker shading to indicate curvature and depth. There is a circular indentation with a smaller central circle on the top surface of the object, creating a focal point. The artist’s signature, “T. Fumagalli,” is located in the lower right corner inside the bordered area. There are faint stains visible on the background of the image, but no other objects or decorations are present.
title: Inkwell
